_comment: duplicate-doc-drift allowlist. The SANCTIONED-DUPLICATE set: framework-owned docs that legitimately ship at the same basename across multiple paths and whose content is EXPECTED to differ (so a content-drift finding on them would be a false positive). Enforced by scripts/checks/duplicate-doc-drift.js. The enforcer already scopes to non-skill / non-template / non-fixture / non-release-capsule .md docs, so an entry here is only for a real shipped duplicate that drifts BY DESIGN (per-pod role docs, mode protocols, per-directory READMEs). Each rule matches a basename plus a set of directory globs; a duplicate GROUP is suppressed only if EVERY shipped path in it matches one of the rule's dir-globs (a member outside the sanctioned dirs is NOT exempted). A rule that matches no group is surfaced as a stale-allowlist note. Keep SMALL.

pairs.reason: Per-pod build-chain role doc — frontend/backend/security each ship their own builder.md by design (pod-specialized prompts). Must NOT fail as drift.
Per-pod build-chain role doc — frontend/backend/security each ship their own fixer.md by design. Must NOT fail as drift.
Per-pod build-chain role doc — frontend/backend/security each ship their own reviewer.md by design. Must NOT fail as drift.
Mode protocol doc — adhoc and oneshot each ship their own protocol.md by design (different team shapes). Must NOT fail as drift.

Per-directory README — each library/knowledge-domain/tooling directory ships its own README describing THAT directory (NOT one canonical doc duplicated); identical content would be the bug, not drift.
